question: Use only the bundled MPRINT snapshot revision 4bdee90dff3610816e86d0eed29b4c4d0fe76e89. This is a dataset audit, not a treatment or safety question. Within the complete fluoxetine Gold lactation-plus-PK cohort, find the only PMID that also receives an automated Silver clinical-trial label. Page through its PK-summary outcomes and use only study_context_matched=true rows. Calculate (mean weight at 12 months minus mean birth weight) for the fluoxetine group, then subtract the same change for the control group. Keep the groups separate and ignore duplicate workbook exports. Return the resulting number of grams as an integer only. This arithmetic is not a causal treatment-effect estimate.
